message.content: **Summary:** I reviewed the saved notes and account (2024-11-04 note: order entry closed for the observed holiday, no orders until "tomorrow" — that restriction lapsed on 11-05, so trading is permitted today, 2024-11-06), confirmed the mandate was satisfied (BA is an allowed symbol, buy-only, no cash movement), and checked the live quote of $155.68/$155.72 (last $155.70, as of 15:05Z). I then bought **100 shares of BA at a limit of $155.75** — just at/through the ask, so close to market — for about $15,575, well inside the $25,000 per-order and $50,000 daily caps, leaving the $75,000 cash balance comfortably able to settle the trade. The key figures I relied on, all from BA's FY2023 10-K filed 2024-01-31, were revenue of **$77,794 million**, net income of **–$2,222 million**, diluted EPS of **–$3.67/share**, and operating cash flow of **$5,960 million**; the read is a large revenue base and positive operating cash generation, but still an unprofitable year on both the net income and EPS lines, so I kept the position size modest (roughly 20% of one day's mandate allowance) rather than maximizing the allowance, and I left the existing 50 MSFT shares untouched.
